scripts.db:migrate: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && go tool goose -dir db/migrations postgres "$DATABASE_URL" up
scripts.db:rollback: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && go tool goose -dir db/migrations postgres "$DATABASE_URL" down
scripts.db:status: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && go tool goose -dir db/migrations postgres "$DATABASE_URL" status
scripts.db:new: mkdir -p db/migrations && go tool goose -dir db/migrations -s create
